description: Confirm a signed-PUT still image upload finished, after PUTting the bytes to the upload_url returned by clipform_upload_media_asset. The API verifies the object actually landed in storage before flipping the asset from processing to ready - call this right after the PUT succeeds, or the asset stays invisible in the library. Not needed for video uploads (they settle automatically).

context.description: Describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence - not the tool you're calling.

form_id.description: The form this is for (from clipform_create_form) - a routing hint only, to pick the right workspace. The result still lands in the workspace library, not on a node. Required on an anonymous session, or this lands in a different workspace and clipform_attach_node_media will not find it.

media_asset_id.description: The media_asset_id returned by clipform_upload_media_asset for the still image

name: clipform_complete_media_upload

status.description: The asset's status after this call - ready on success, or its already-settled status when called again (noop)

title: Complete Media Upload
